passives.name: Agony
passives.description: Deal up to 12% more magic damage to champions, scaling with their bonus health (full bonus at 1250 bonus health).
passives.if: t_champion and not t_self and dtype == 'magic' and t_bonus_hp > 0

passives.name: Torment
passives.description: Ability damage sets enemies on fire for 4s, dealing 12.5 + 1.5% AP + 1% of their max health magic damage per second.
passives.if: is_ability and not is_dot and not t_structure and not t_self
